# v1.21.3b1 — House-load sample consistency (beta)

This development beta addresses [issue #10](https://github.com/PlainSeer/ha-alphaess-modbus-tcp/issues/10), where an inconsistent PV, battery and grid power balance could be displayed as zero household consumption.

## Changes

- Treat negative house-load balances as inconsistent samples and share sample handling between the sensors and affected controllers.
- Retain the last valid reading for at most 10 seconds for display and daily energy estimation. Current House Load exposes `estimated: true` and `sample_status: estimated` while held.
- Report unknown after the estimate expires and flag omitted daily-energy intervals as incomplete. Missing or failed reads do not qualify for this estimate.
- Force Export/Import wait for consistent power when seeding and skip invalid servo updates. Excess Export cannot resume using a held house load. Peak Shaving skips inconsistent samples while retaining its existing mode and SoC safety actions.
- Preserve existing dispatch deadlines, command encodings and direct Force Charging/Discharging and generic Dispatch command construction. No additional Modbus register reads are introduced.

## Validation and beta scope

426 Python tests pass on HA 2024.12.5 / Python 3.12 and HA 2026.10.4 / Python 3.14 with pymodbus 3.7.4. GitHub checks also cover dashboard tests, HACS and hassfest. Tests simulate the inverter; hardware validation is still required.

Automations reading Current House Load may now see a brief held estimate or unknown instead of a false zero. The filtered sensor uses the same underlying data and is not an independent measurement.

This beta does not change counter restoration after restart or retroactively correct recorded consumption history. It does not establish that the sampling issue caused any particular forecast or planning problem.

The previous stable release remains v1.21.2.
